bio.text: Da'Shone Hughey is an independent candidate for New Jersey's 8th Congressional District, according to the New Jersey Globe.

A June 29, 2026 press release issued on behalf of his campaign says he is running under the slogan "We The People" and describes him as an entrepreneur, educator, author and technology innovator; it names his book as PhD Ready by 18.

sources.title: Husband-and-wife duo from Tennessee will run as pro-life independents for competitive N.J. seats
Da'Shone Hughey announces campaign for U.S. Congress in New Jersey's 8th District
